title: Source Editor undoes editing after keypress
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: v4.7.dev.custom_build [3c5e56102] (`master` as of today)

This is the first time I've seen this, and I typically build `master` a few times a week.  It happens on every line in every `.gd` file in the project I've tried.

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev (3c5e56102) - macOS Tahoe (26.2.0) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M1 Max (Apple7) - Apple M1 Max (10 threads) - 32.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

Any edit in any source file is undone after a few hundred milliseconds.  I've tested with and without using VSCode connected to the LSP.

I've attached a video.  I am only pressing `#`: the cursor placement is also occurring automatically.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/57e269e1-63b5-452d-8295-8a1dcaa0eb3d

### Steps to reproduce

I've been unable to reproduce this with a blank project while trying to build an MRP.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I'm sorta hoping very recent changes to the editor will point to the culprit.  If not, it will be a pretty long and involved process to strip down the project until this no longer occurs.  

I've spent a few hours on this today, and will continue over the next few days to try to create an MRP.
